where: favorites, list rows, orders, home and folder screens

source.implements: The home screen as two folders, Favorites (lists starred on this phone, none at first) and All lists (every list, the filters); each folder in the order chosen: newest (date in the source line, later-added first on a tie), A to Z, by faction (bands, A to Z within); a star on each row
Favorites and All lists are screens of their own: title, Back to home, valid on a reload, calm for an update reload, one-list app skips them

Taps: a folder (replacing the empty Favorites so Back still goes home), the order sheet, a star (Find redraws its top bar only; unstarring in Favorites offers Undo), Random from a folder; the star on Find; removing an imported list drops its star

.arw{display:flex; align-items:stretch; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.arw > .row{flex:1; min-width:0; border-bottom:0}
.fav{flex:none; width:44px; display:grid; place-items:center; margin-right:-10px; color:var(--muted)}
.fav svg{width:22px; height:22px}
.fav.on, .icon-btn.fav.on{color:var(--accent); --star-fill:currentColor}
.fav:active{opacity:.6}
.icon-btn.fav{width:44px; color:var(--fg)}
.hll{display:flex; align-items:center; min-width:0}
.srt{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; min-height:36px; margin-left:-2px; padding:0 2px}
.srt .chev{color:var(--muted)}
.srt:active{opacity:.6}

source.implements: Star and folder icons (Lucide, as the others); the row + star pair; the order button

The gate renders the folders (empty Favorites, two starred, All lists in each order, the order sheet) and checks counts, stars (kept, shown on Find, removed there), Back and reload on a folder, and each order against the data
